text: ロコンや　リザードに　おぼえさせると　よいぞ！

structure.jp: ロコンや　リザードに

patterns.name: 〜といい
patterns.span: おぼえさせると　よいぞ
patterns.explanation: A verb plus と and いい means 'it would be good to do that', a way of giving advice. よい is a more formal いい. おぼえさせると よい = 'you should teach it'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: This ending means making or letting someone do the action. おぼえる is 'to learn', so おぼえさせる = 'make it learn', that is, 'teach it'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, mostly male way to add force to what you say. よいぞ = 'it's good, I tell you!'
